# Vendored Eclipse SDK binaries

Pinned Eclipse SDK 4.40 Linux x86_64 runtime/build bundles, imported from the official
archive verified by SHA-512. Source and documentation bundles are omitted. The
individual files, bundle identities and SHA-256 values are recorded in vendor.json.
All embedded license/about files remain intact. Source URL and original archive
checksum are also in vendor.json. This directory is read-only to normal builds.
A toolchain update is a reviewed repository change, not an automatic download.
